name: Shimo-Takaido
tagline: Shinjuku in 12 minutes and Shibuya in 20 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Keio and Tokyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 37 minutes to Otemachi, 12 minutes to Shinjuku, 20 minutes to Shibuya and 43 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 45.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 9.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 45.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 38.2 m to 47.6 m, a difference of 9.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 16 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 吉川内科小児科病院, about 2 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is うめとぴあ, about 21 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Keio Line and Tokyu Setagaya Line. The lines are split between operators (Keio runs 1 line and Tokyu runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Keio Line runs at 145% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 下高井戸→明大前, which includes this station. Tokyu Setagaya Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥210,000 to ¥220,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For safety, Matsubara; for rail connections, Shimo-Takaido.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shimo-Takaido. Matsubara has only the Tokyu Setagaya Line, so Shimo-Takaido is the better connected. To Tokyo, for instance, Matsubara takes 9 minutes longer. On safety, though, Matsubara comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Meidaimae; for lower rent, Shimo-Takaido.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shimo-Takaido. Meidaimae has the Keio Line and Keio Inokashira Line, a different set from Shimo-Takaido. To Shibuya, for instance, Meidaimae is 7 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥5,000 more at Meidaimae.

goodFor: People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: The data does not show a drawback particular to this station
noiseSources: The 首都高速4号新宿線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
日大通り;瀬田貫井線 (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
